borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Cycle parking spaces for staff/visitors/children must be implemented in accordance with The Local Plan Policy DMT3 and The
London Plan 2021 policy T5. Thereafter, it shall be retained as such in perpetuity.</p>

<p><span style="background-color: rgb(229, 229, 229);">&nbsp;</span>The premises shall be used as a children's care home for three child resident and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class C2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification)).</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><ul><li>Location Plan&nbsp;&nbsp;- drawing no.PL01 - dated June 2025</li><li>Site Plan - drawing no.PL02 - dated June 2025</li><li>Proposed Floor Plans - drawing no.PL04 - dated June 2025</li></ul><p>No other drawings or documents apply.</p>

<p><strong><span style="font-size:11.0pt;line-height:
115%;font-family:&quot;Calibri&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Calibri;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:
EN-US;mso-bidi-language:AR-SA;font-weight:normal">The development must provide
adequate refuse storage, considering its anticipated use by multiple occupants
and exceeding the typical needs of a single household. The storage space must
be clearly identified. No bins or rubbish shall be kept on the public highway
on any time other than designated refuse collection days.&nbsp;</span></strong></p>

<p>The proposed development shall achieve Secured by design principles to the satisfaction of the local 
authority &amp; Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for 
its written approval prior to the first occupation of the approved development. All security measures 
applied to the approved development shall be permanently retained thereafter.</p>
description: Change of use of the dwelling (C3) to a residential care home for up to two children aged 11-17 with two rotating overnight carers and a day manager (C2)
